tablist._doc_enabled: Set to true to enable the custom tablist header/footer system. False restores vanilla tablist.
tablist._doc_refreshInterval: How often the tablist header/footer is updated, in ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second. Lower = smoother animation but more network traffic.
_doc_header: The text displayed ABOVE the player list.
Supports an array of strings for animated frames (each frame shown for refreshInterval ticks).
Use a single string for a static header.
Colour codes: use & followed by the code (0-9, a-f, k, l, m, n, o, r).
{online}        — online player count (respects vanish hide setting)
_doc_footer: The text displayed BELOW the player list.
Same array animation and placeholder support as header.
_doc_playerFormat: How each player's name appears in the player list rows.
This controls the display name shown next to the player's head in the tablist.
_doc_playerFormat_spacing: The space before {player} is load-bearing. NeoEssentials TRIMS group prefixes on setprefix,
so '&2[Mod] ' is stored as '&2[Mod]' and a prefix can never carry its own trailing space —
without the space here the tablist renders '[Mod]Steve'. Chat is unaffected: chat.json
hardcodes its own spacing rather than using {prefix}.
Cost: non-staff (prefix '&7', a colour code with no glyph) render as ' Steve' with one
leading space. Accepted as the lesser evil.
tablist._doc_hideVanished: When true, vanished players are hidden from the {online} count and from other players' tablists. Players with 'neoessentials.vanish.see' still see vanished players.
tablist._doc_showAfkIndicator: When true, AFK players have the afkSuffix appended to their name in the tablist.
tablist._doc_afkSuffix: The text appended to AFK players' names in the tablist. Supports colour codes with &.
_doc_groups: MUST BE NON-EMPTY. An empty {} does NOT work: NeoEssentials treats an empty map as unset
and re-injects its own defaults on load — 0.35.1 shipped "groups": {} and the live file came
back with admin/mod/vip. Non-empty values are respected (header and playerFormat survive
untouched), so the way to neutralise the feature is to define it, not to blank it.
NeoEssentials 1.0.3 added per-group tablist header/footer overrides. Its stock 'admin'
default is a red-gradient '⚑ ADMIN PANEL ⚑' header plus an 'Admin tools: /vanish /kick /ban
/mute' footer, which replaced our rotating stats line for admins from 0.34.1 onward.
Only 'admin' needs overriding: their other defaults are keyed 'mod' and 'vip', and our
groups are named 'moderator' and 'default', so those never match anything.
The entry below is a verbatim copy of the global header/footer, so admins see exactly what
everyone else sees. Keep it in sync if you edit those.
Note NeoEssentials rewrites this file on load: it strips every _doc_* key and appends its
own missing keys. These comments therefore live only in the repo copy, never on the server.
GENERAL HAZARD: a NeoEssentials upgrade can introduce config keys that arrive ENABLED.
1.0.3 also injected independentMode, nametagSettings, players, proxy, fakePlayers and
layout here. Pin anything whose default you don't want.
_doc_groupColors: NEUTRAL ON PURPOSE — never blank this. Same trap as groups above: an empty {} is treated
as unset and NeoEssentials re-injects its defaults (owner/admin/mod/vip/default, with
admin = &c), which tints an admin's NAME red in the player list.
Rank colour belongs on the [Admin]/[Mod] tag only, and that already comes from the group
prefix via {prefix} in playerFormat. So every group we actually have is mapped to plain
white here, which is a no-op on top of playerFormat's leading &f.
Keys must be the exact group name from permissions.json — our mod group is 'moderator',
not 'mod'; a 'mod' key silently never matches.
